|lore=Company that produces current generation of Star Destroyers, as well as Nebulon-B Frigate. Ship yards are extremely well defended.
|game_text=Deploy on table. [Virtual] Fear Will Keep Them In Line is canceled. Unique (•) ''Imperial''-class Star Destroyers are deploy -1, gain an additional permanent pilot of ability 2, and are immune to attrition < 4. During your deploy phase, may use 2 Force to deploy a battleground system from Reserve Deck; reshuffle. (Immune to Alter.)

|notes=The set was released 21 November 2003. The complete first sheet remains unlocated. The comparison dates each surviving issuer text. [https://web.archive.org/web/20031202154611id_/http://www.swccgpc.com:80/interior.htm Players Committee release announcement]. The first surviving text limits the opponent’s loss to 2 Force from Fear Will Keep Them In Line. The remaster cancels the specifically marked virtual card. Both retain the unique Imperial-class bonuses and one two-Force battleground system deployment in your deploy phase. [https://web.archive.org/web/20090816063441id_/http://www.starwarsccg.org/Resources/AR/AR1.7.1.pdf#page=21 Period One Rule].
